Two separate props for a 2D point-and-click comedy adventure game, drawn large, far apart, not touching, in exactly the drawing style, line work and coloring of the reference images. On the left: the white coffee mug from the first reference image, full of black coffee, without steam, standing, seen from the side slightly from above. On the right: the old brown leather book from the second reference image, but closed and lifeless: no face, no eyes, no mouth, no tongue; a brand new unopened gift still wrapped in clear shiny cellophane with a few white highlight streaks and a small yellow round sticker, standing upright, its front cover and spine visible. Bold thick dark-brown outlines, flat colors with simple soft shading, warm muted palette. No text, no letters, no numbers,
plain flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background everywhere around the subject, no ground, no shadows, no gradient
